tweets.text:
FOOT GUIDE CONVICTED -SMUGGLING RESULTING IN DEATH!!
Through the dedicated efforts of USBP agents and the U.S. Attorney’s Office, Jorge Fontes-Garcia was convicted on August 5, 2025, and sentenced to 10 years and 10 months in federal prison. Fontes was found responsible for smuggling a group of individuals in 2023, which tragically resulted in the death of one individual.

Charges: 🔺8 U.S.C.§1324; Alien Smuggling.

We are seeking all charges applicable and maximum sentences for these criminals who deliberately break our laws and put the lives of others at risk! 

¡TRAFICANTE DE PERSONAS CONDENADO! CASO DE CONTRABANDO CON RESULTADO DE MUERTE! Gracias a los esfuerzos dedicados de la Patrulla Fronteriza y la Oficina del Fiscal de los Estados Unidos, Jorge Fontes-García fue condenado el 5 de agosto de 2025 y sentenciado a 130 meses en prisión federal. Fontes fue declarado responsable de traficar un grupo de personas en el año 2023, lo que lamentablemente resultó en la muerte de uno.

Cargos: 🔺8 U.S.C.§1324; Tráfico de personas indocumentadas. 

¡Estamos aplicando todos los cargos posibles y las máximas penas para estos criminales que deliberadamente violan nuestras leyes y ponen en riesgo la vida de otros!

tweets.text:
DOUBLE TROUBLE: Nearly $11 Million Worth of Meth & Heroin Stopped in Its Tracks!

 8/8- A traffic stop in Seguin, TX, quickly escalated into a major drug seizure. USBP agents assisted the Guadalupe County Sheriff's Office in interviewing two Mexican nationals traveling on I-10, that led to the discovery of several bundles tightly packed inside a hidden truck bed compartment. Inside, was a deadly haul of 325 lbs. of meth and 17 lbs. of heroin. Both the driver and passenger entered the U.S. on visitor visas- but their "stay" has now been extended, to face federal charges for conspiracy possession with intent to deliver.

Recently retired from Border Patrol?
We want you back!
We’re seeking to reinstate retired agents to rejoin the agency and continue the great work we’ve accomplished the last six months. You must be retired for at least one year before the closing of the announcement and no more than five years prior to the closing date of the announcement.
Benefits may include:
•The availability of a salary offset waiver, allowing you to retain your full retirement annuity and full salary while re-employed
•Recruitment incentive
•An expedited pre-employment process
•Accelerated re-entry training conducted at the sector.
Rejoin your green family here:
https://t.co/eehj5VUupR
